For quantifying the effect size and direction, we consider a Generalized Additive Model (GAM) approach. This allows us to interpret the coefficients and explanatory power of the parameters, including linear and nonlinear effects.

## 3) clear plots, console, connections, memory

library(mgcv)

Create cluster for parallel

```{r}

if (exists("cl")) try(stopCluster(cl), silent = TRUE)

cl <- makeCluster(56)      # or a bit fewer to leave headroom

length(cl)                 # should be 56


```

Fit the GAM model for predicting adults

```{r}

anom <- read.table("/g/data/es60/SEAPODYM/pearse_GAMs/anomalous_values_SEAPODYM_WCPO.txt", header = TRUE, sep = ",")

anom$larvae_biomass_TF <- log10(abs(anom$larvae_biomass)+1.0) * sign(anom$larvae_biomass)
anom$juvenile_biomass_TF <- log10(abs(anom$juvenile_biomass)+1.0) * sign(anom$juvenile_biomass)
anom$adult_biomass_TF <- log10(abs(anom$adult_biomass)+1.0) * sign(anom$adult_biomass)

```

GAM to predict adult skipjack tuna

```{r}


k1 <- 5

### baseline
anom$season_num <- match(anom$season, c("DJF", "MAM", "JJA", "SON"))
anom$season_num <- ifelse(anom$season == "DJF", 1,
                  ifelse(anom$season == "MAM", 2,
                  ifelse(anom$season == "JJA", 3,
                  ifelse(anom$season == "SON", 4, NA))))


```

```{r}

gam_anom_adultTF_FS5 <- bam(
  adult_biomass_TF ~
    s(sst, k = k1, bs = "ts") +
    s(T_L1, k = k1, bs = "ts") +
    s(U_L3, k = k1, bs = "ts") +
    s(O2_L2, k = k1, bs = "ts") +
    s(zeu, k = k1, bs = "ts") +
    s(T_L2, k = k1, bs = "ts") +
    ti(sst, lon, lat, bs=c("cr","tp","tp"), k=c(k1, 120), m=2) +
    ti(T_L1, lon, lat, bs=c("cr","tp","tp"), k=c(k1, 120), m=2) +
    ti(U_L3, lon, lat, bs=c("cr","tp","tp"), k=c(k1, 120), m=2) +
    ti(O2_L2, lon, lat, bs=c("cr","tp","tp"), k=c(k1, 120), m=2) +
    ti(zeu, lon, lat, bs=c("cr","tp","tp"), k=c(k1, 120), m=2) +
    ti(T_L2, lon, lat, bs=c("cr","tp","tp"), k=c(k1, 120), m=2),
  data = anom,
  method = "fREML",
  select = TRUE,
  cluster = cl,
  gc.level = 2
)
summary(gam_anom_adultTF_FS5)


```

Create the anomalies required for the GAM in the my_imfs dataset

```{r}

## vector of base variable names you have IMFs for:
## adjust this to what you actually have
vars <- c("sst", "T_L1", "T_L2", "U_L3", "zeu", "O2_L2")  # <- add more here

# time index (same for all rows)
t <- seq_len(nrow(my_imfs))

for (v in vars) {
  # column names
  v_noHF <- paste0(v, "_noHF")
  v_noMF <- paste0(v, "_noMF")
  v_noLF <- paste0(v, "_noLF")

  v_HF   <- paste0(v, "_HF")
  v_MF   <- paste0(v, "_MF")
  v_LF   <- paste0(v, "_LF")
  v_T    <- paste0(v, "_T")
  v_Td   <- paste0(v, "_T_detrended")
  v_Tc   <- paste0(v, "_T_centered")

  ## HF/MF/LF from “noX” versions
  my_imfs[[v_HF]] <- my_imfs[[v]] - my_imfs[[v_noHF]]
  my_imfs[[v_MF]] <- my_imfs[[v]] - my_imfs[[v_noMF]]
  my_imfs[[v_LF]] <- my_imfs[[v]] - my_imfs[[v_noLF]]

  ## total residual T
  my_imfs[[v_T]] <- my_imfs[[v]] -
    (my_imfs[[v_MF]] + my_imfs[[v_LF]] + my_imfs[[v_HF]])
  
  my_imfs[[v_Tc]] <- my_imfs[[v_T]] - ave(my_imfs[[v_T]], my_imfs$lon, my_imfs$lat, FUN = function(z) mean(z, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  ## detrend T (linear trend) – NA-safe
  x <- my_imfs[[v_T]]
  ok <- !is.na(x)
  trend <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  trend[ok] <- lm(x[ok] ~ t[ok])$fitted.values

  my_imfs[[v_Td]] <- x - trend

}


```

Do the predictions with the GAM using High-Freq, Mid-Freq, Low-Freq and long-term trend anomalies!

  newdata  = df_HF_imfs,
  type     = "response",

  block.size = 100000  # try 50k–200k; omit if your mgcv doesn’t have this arg
)

adultTF_HF_se  <- p$se.fit

```{r}

decompose_predictors <- function(mod, newdata, cluster = NULL, block.size = 100000) {

  # term-level contributions on the linear predictor scale
  pt <- mgcv::predict.gam(
    mod,
    newdata  = newdata,
    type     = "terms",
    se.fit   = FALSE,
    cluster  = cluster,
    block.size = block.size
  )
  term_names <- colnames(pt)

  # helper: sum all terms that contain a given pattern in their name
  sum_by_pattern <- function(pattern) {
    idx <- grep(pattern, term_names)
    if (length(idx) == 0L) return(rep(0, nrow(newdata)))
    rowSums(pt[, idx, drop = FALSE])
  }

  # one column per oceanographic predictor
  contrib_T_L1 <- sum_by_pattern("T_L1")
  contrib_sst  <- sum_by_pattern("sst")
  contrib_U_L3 <- sum_by_pattern("U_L3")
  contrib_O2_L2<- sum_by_pattern("O2_L2")
  contrib_zeu  <- sum_by_pattern("zeu")
  contrib_T_L2 <- sum_by_pattern("T_L2")

  # intercept (same for all rows)
  intercept <- attr(pt, "constant")
  if (is.null(intercept) || length(intercept) == 0L) intercept <- 0

  drop <- c("adultTF_T_L1","adultTF_sst","adultTF_U_L3","adultTF_O2_L2",
          "adultTF_zeu","adultTF_T_L2","adultTF_intercept")
  newdata[drop] <- NULL

  new_cols <- data.frame(
    adultTF_T_L1  = contrib_T_L1,
    adultTF_sst   = contrib_sst,
    adultTF_U_L3  = contrib_U_L3,
    adultTF_O2_L2 = contrib_O2_L2,
    adultTF_zeu   = contrib_zeu,
    adultTF_T_L2  = contrib_T_L2,
    adultTF_intercept = rep(intercept, nrow(newdata)),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  out <- cbind(newdata, new_cols)
  return(out)
}

# Add predictor-specific contributions
df_HF_imfs <- decompose_predictors(gam_anom_adultTF_FS5, df_HF_imfs, cluster = cl)
df_MF_imfs <- decompose_predictors(gam_anom_adultTF_FS5, df_MF_imfs, cluster = cl)
df_LF_imfs <- decompose_predictors(gam_anom_adultTF_FS5, df_LF_imfs, cluster = cl)
df_T_imfs  <- decompose_predictors(gam_anom_adultTF_FS5, df_T_imfs,  cluster = cl)

```
